abstract: Back up and restore the OpenClaw personal-assistant state directory (config, workspace, sessions, skills) to a Tigris bucket. Covers consistent backups with safe SQLite handling (backup API, WAL/journal exclusion), dry-run-by-default restore with a pre-restore safety copy, point-in-time rollback via bucket snapshots, zero-copy assistant clones via forks, and scheduling with OpenClaw cron or system cron.
